title: Frontend Engineer Mastery Roadmap
summary: Deepen your expertise in modern frontend development, from solid fundamentals to professional‑grade projects and job readiness. Follow the four phases to build best‑practice skills, a showcase portfolio, and a confident transition into the industry.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Establish rock‑solid core web fundamentals and tooling.

milestones.title: HTML & CSS Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Create semantic, responsive pages that work across browsers.

tasks.title: Read HTML5 spec overview
tasks.description: Skim the MDN HTML5 guide focusing on document structure and semantics.

tasks.title: Build a static landing page
tasks.description: Implement a multi‑section page using Flexbox and Grid, ensuring mobile responsiveness.

tasks.title: Practice accessibility basics
tasks.description: Add proper heading hierarchy, alt text, and ARIA landmarks to the landing page.

tasks.title: Reflect on markup choices
tasks.description: Write a short note on why each semantic element was chosen and how it aids accessibility.

milestones.title: JavaScript Core Concepts
milestones.outcome: Write clean, functional JavaScript for interactive web features.

tasks.title: Watch ES6+ fundamentals video
tasks.description: View the freeCodeCamp ES6 tutorial covering let/const, arrow functions, and modules.

tasks.title: Implement a todo widget
tasks.description: Create a vanilla JS todo list with add, toggle, and delete actions, storing state in localStorage.

tasks.title: Practice debugging with DevTools
tasks.description: Set breakpoints, step through code, and inspect variables in Chrome DevTools.

tasks.title: Connect with a JS community thread
tasks.description: Post a question or answer on Stack Overflow about a subtle scope issue you encountered.

milestones.title: Version Control Basics
milestones.outcome: Manage code history and collaborate using Git.

tasks.title: Read Git basics on Git‑SCM site
tasks.description: Study the official Git documentation on init, commit, branch, and merge.

tasks.title: Initialize a repo for previous project
tasks.description: Create a Git repository, commit the landing page and todo widget, and push to GitHub.

tasks.title: Practice branching workflow
tasks.description: Create a feature branch, make a change, and merge back using a pull request.

tasks.title: Reflect on commit messages
tasks.description: Write guidelines for clear, conventional commit messages for future projects.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Gain proficiency in TypeScript, React, and performance‑focused development.

milestones.title: TypeScript Foundations
milestones.outcome: Add static typing to JavaScript projects for safer code.

tasks.title: Read TypeScript handbook intro
tasks.description: Study the official TypeScript handbook sections on types, interfaces, and enums.

tasks.title: Migrate todo widget to TS
tasks.description: Convert the previous vanilla JS todo app to TypeScript, fixing type errors.

tasks.title: Practice strict compiler settings
tasks.description: Enable strict mode, noImplicitAny, and run tsc to catch potential bugs.

tasks.title: Reflect on type benefits
tasks.description: Write a brief note on how types prevented a runtime error in the migration.

milestones.title: React Essentials
milestones.outcome: Build component‑based UIs with modern React patterns.

tasks.title: Watch React official tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the React docs tutorial to create a simple counter app using hooks.

tasks.title: Build a reusable card component
tasks.description: Create a Card component with props for title, image, and actions, using TypeScript.

tasks.title: Practice state management with useReducer
tasks.description: Refactor the card list to use useReducer for adding/removing cards.

tasks.title: Connect with React Discord
tasks.description: Join the Reactiflux Discord and introduce yourself, asking about best practices.

milestones.title: Accessibility & Performance
milestones.outcome: Deliver fast, inclusive experiences meeting WCAG and Core Web Vitals.

tasks.title: Read WCAG 2.1 summary on W3C
tasks.description: Study the key success criteria for perceivable, operable, and understandable content.

tasks.title: Audit the landing page with Lighthouse
tasks.description: Run Chrome Lighthouse, note scores, and list three improvements.

tasks.title: Build focus-visible styles
tasks.description: Add CSS to ensure keyboard users see clear focus outlines on all interactive elements.

tasks.title: Reflect on performance fixes
tasks.description: Document how lazy‑loading images and reducing CSS size improved LCP.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio‑ready projects that showcase depth and best practices.

milestones.title: Responsive Portfolio Site
milestones.outcome: A personal site demonstrating layout, animation, and SEO best practices.

tasks.title: Plan site structure on paper
tasks.description: Sketch pages, navigation, and content hierarchy for the portfolio.

tasks.title: Build site with React & TS
tasks.description: Develop the portfolio using React, TypeScript, and CSS Modules, ensuring mobile responsiveness.

tasks.title: Implement SEO meta tags
tasks.description: Add appropriate title, description, Open Graph, and schema markup.

tasks.title: Deploy to GitHub Pages
tasks.description: Configure the repository for static site hosting and verify live URL.

tasks.title: Reflect on project workflow
tasks.description: Write a short post‑mortem covering challenges, tools, and next steps.

milestones.title: API Dashboard Project
milestones.outcome: A data‑driven dashboard that consumes a public API with robust error handling.

tasks.title: Select a public API and read docs
tasks.description: Choose an open API (e.g., OpenWeather) and note authentication and rate limits.

tasks.title: Create data fetching layer with React Query
tasks.description: Set up React Query to fetch, cache, and refetch data efficiently.

tasks.title: Practice error UI states
tasks.description: Design and implement loading spinners, error messages, and empty states.

tasks.title: Add chart components with Recharts
tasks.description: Visualize fetched data using responsive charts from the Recharts library.

tasks.title: Connect with a mentor on CodeMentor
tasks.description: Schedule a short review session to get feedback on code quality and UI.

milestones.title: Component Library
milestones.outcome: A reusable UI component set with documentation and storybook.

tasks.title: Define component API design
tasks.description: Write prop specifications for Button, Modal, and Tooltip components.

tasks.title: Build components with Storybook
tasks.description: Implement each component in React/TS and create interactive Storybook stories.

tasks.title: Practice unit testing with Jest
tasks.description: Write tests for component behavior, props validation, and accessibility attributes.

tasks.title: Document usage guidelines
tasks.description: Create a markdown guide covering installation, theming, and best practices.

tasks.title: Reflect on library publishing
tasks.description: Note steps needed to publish to npm and versioning considerations.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish advanced topics, interview prep, and professional positioning.

milestones.title: Advanced Web Performance
milestones.outcome: Optimize apps to meet Core Web Vitals consistently.

tasks.title: Read Web.dev performance guide
tasks.description: Study the free Web.dev article on optimizing render‑blocking resources.

tasks.title: Implement code‑splitting with React.lazy
tasks.description: Refactor the dashboard to lazy‑load heavy components and routes.

tasks.title: Practice measuring with Web Vitals library
tasks.description: Add the web-vitals npm package and log LCP, FID, CLS metrics in production builds.

tasks.title: Connect with a performance expert on Twitter
tasks.description: Tweet a question about third‑party script impact and note the response.

tasks.title: Reflect on performance trade‑offs
tasks.description: Write a brief comparison of bundle size vs. runtime speed after optimizations.

milestones.title: Interview & Job Search Skills
milestones.outcome: Confidently tackle technical interviews and present your portfolio.

tasks.title: Read Cracking the Coding Interview front‑end chapter
tasks.description: Study the recommended patterns for DOM manipulation and algorithm questions.

tasks.title: Practice whiteboard coding of a sorting algorithm
tasks.description: Write and explain quicksort on paper, focusing on time/space complexity.

tasks.title: Build a mock interview with a peer
tasks.description: Conduct a 45‑minute pair‑programming session covering React hooks and state.

tasks.title: Update LinkedIn with project links
tasks.description: Add the portfolio, dashboard, and component library URLs with concise descriptions.

tasks.title: Reflect on interview feedback
tasks.description: Summarize strengths and improvement areas after each mock interview.

milestones.title: Professional Habits & Continuous Learning
milestones.outcome: Adopt workflows and resources for ongoing growth as a frontend engineer.

tasks.title: Read article on TypeScript monorepos
tasks.description: Explore a free blog post about scaling TS across multiple packages.

tasks.title: Set up ESLint & Prettier config
tasks.description: Configure linting and formatting for consistent code style across projects.

tasks.title: Practice writing technical blog post
tasks.description: Draft a 800‑word post on a recent performance optimization you implemented.

tasks.title: Connect with a senior frontend engineer on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Send a personalized message requesting a brief coffee chat about career paths.

tasks.title: Reflect on learning pipeline
tasks.description: Create a checklist for weekly learning, project work, and community engagement.
